implementation.placement_authority: median-water UV0 station/lateral coordinates, centerline curvature classification, deterministic module masks, and complex traces against RaftSimFullReachTerrain

accepted_corrections: Vertex alpha now represents a narrow wet toe instead of incorrectly darkening every bank vertex as fully wet.
Bend classification, discontinuous module masks, multi-attempt rock hierarchy, and bark-clad root segments are deterministic and source-conditioned.
The derived actor remains transient, non-colliding, non-navigable, and is destroyed after the five captures.
rejection_reasons: The cutbank profiles read as pale pyramidal berms rather than eroded faces, with hard longitudinal seams at module boundaries.
Chili Bar and Meat Grinder gain the strongest artifacts; Troublemaker and Coloma remain planar and synthetic; Salmon Falls is effectively unchanged.
The 568 root segments are not camera-legible and do not create credible exposed root systems or undercuts.
Scan rocks remain visually isolated from the generated bank surface and lack sediment embedding and South Fork lithologic specificity.
Water, foliage, terrain, and lighting remain far below the photographic target, and no named reviewer approved the result.
manual_review.corrective_action: Stop procedural cross-section authoring in this review seam. Replace it with production-quality scanned/authored bank modules whose end caps, material layers, roots, sediment embedding, wetness, and vegetation transitions are created and reviewed as coherent assets before source-conditioned placement.
manual_review.candidate_retention: retain source only as an opt-in non-authoritative integration prototype and retain captures/ledger as negative evidence; do not promote v198 geometry, materials, roots, placement, or media
